AppearanceColours.description: `spec.appearance.colours`: each one a hex colour, `#rgb` or `#rrggbb`.

footerBackground.description: The page footer, six hex digits after a hash, such as 0f172a.

footerText.description: Text and links in the footer, at least 4.5:1 on its background, six hex digits after a hash, such as ffffff.

headerBackground.description: The open data portal's header bar, six hex digits after a hash, such as 0b5394.

headerText.description: Text and links in the header bar, at least 4.5:1 on its background, six hex digits after a hash, such as ffffff.

link.description: Links in the page, at least 4.5:1 on the background, six hex digits after a hash, such as 1d4ed8 (T-7744).

secondary.description: Secondary colour for links and focus, e.g. `#0f766e`.

AppearanceDisplay.description: `spec.appearance.display` (T-7743): data only, every name one of a fixed list.

AppearanceFont.description: `spec.appearance.font`: a system font stack, never a web font (T-7410).

oneOf.description: The platform's interface font.
A humanist sans serif.
A book serif.
A monospace font.

intro.description: The introduction under it in Markdown of at most 2 KiB, e.g. `Dáta mesta na **jednom mieste**.`; raw HTML shows as text.

title.description: The home page's heading, one line, e.g. `Otvorené dáta Banskej Bystrice`.

label.description: The text of the link, e.g. `Mesto`.

url.description: An `https://` or `http://` address or a path on the portal starting `/`, e.g. `https://www.banskabystrica.sk`.

AppearancePage.description: `spec.appearance.pages[]`: one page of the open data portal in one language (T-7031).

lang.description: The language as a two-letter code, e.g. `sk`.

markdown.description: The page in Markdown, its first `# heading` the title, at most 16 KiB, e.g. `# Podpora\n\nNapíšte nám na opendata@mesto.sk.`; raw HTML shows as text.

Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

component.description: The digest of a `wasm` App's server component, taken from the checked bundle and stored by it in the object store; what the WASM host loads and checks (AP-151).

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

oneOf.description: The primary colour filled in.
The primary colour as border and text.
Flat cards with a border only.
A soft shadow under each card.

ContentWidth.description: `spec.appearance.width`: how wide the open data portal's content runs (T-7744).

oneOf.description: About 60 rem, for reading.
About 76 rem, the built-in width.
About 90 rem, for wide tables.

DatasetDisplay.description: `spec.appearance.display.dataset`: each list left empty shows the level above's.

about.description: The about table's rows in order, each at most once; a row left out is hidden. A DCAT field name (`publisher`, `license`, `rights`, `source`, `keyword`, `accrualPeriodicity`, `issued`, `modified`, `nextUpdate`, `spatial`, `temporal`, `contactPoint`, `identifier`, `conformsTo`) or a dataset extra as `extras.<key>`, e.g. `[license, publisher, modified]`.

sections.description: The sections that show, in order, each at most once; a section left out is hidden. One of `publisher`, `subscribe`, `explorer`, `map`, `visualizations`, `dashboards`, `about`, `live`, `mcp`, `resources`, `additional-info`, `shacl`, e.g. `[{name: about}, {name: resources}]`.

fields.description: What each dataset shows after its title, in order, as a table column or a card line: `notes`, `format`, `publisher`, `modified`, e.g. `[format, modified]`; empty shows the level above's.

oneOf.description: One card per dataset with its description.
One table row per dataset.

heading.description: Its heading per language in place of the built-in one, plain text, e.g. `{sk: O dátach, en: About the data}`; a Portal's languages are those of `spec.languages`.

HarvestBudget.description: The most a harvest run of a source reads before it fails and changes nothing (ODP-13).

text.description: One line under it per language.

title.description: The card's heading per language, e.g. `{sk: Rozpočet}`.

url.description: An `https://` address or a path on the portal, e.g. `/page/rozpocet`.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

bodyFont.description: The body text's typeface over `font`, from the same fixed set, e.g. `system`.

cardShadow.description: Whether cards carry a shadow: `soft` (the default) or `none`.

city.description: The city or region the Organization serves, e.g. `Banská Bystrica`.

colours.description: The colour tokens, each a hex colour such as `#0b5394`.

contactEmail.description: The contact address in the footer and the open data portal, e.g. `opendata@banskabystrica.sk`.

css.description: A `kind: Portal`'s own stylesheet for its open data portal, at most 32 KiB (T-7745): style rules and `@media` alone, every selector scoped to that portal's pages, properties from a fixed list without `content`, positioning, `z-index` or hiding, `url()` only of `/files/{sha256}/{name}` of the portal's files; e.g. `.site-header { background: navy }`. An Organization's appearance refuses it: each portal carries its own.

datasetList.description: How the open data portal lists datasets: `cards` (the default) or a compact `table`.

display.description: Which parts of the open data portal's dataset and dataset list pages show, in which order and under which heading (T-7743); a page left out shows the level above's.

faviconSvg.description: The favicon as an SVG document of at most 64 KiB, under the same rules as the logo.

font.description: The open data portal's typeface, one of a fixed set of system font stacks, so no font is fetched from another host: `system`, `humanist`, `serif` or `mono` (T-7410).

fontSize.description: The base text size in pixels, 14 to 18, e.g. `16`.

footerLinks.description: Links the open data portal's footer adds after its own, under the same rules.

headingFont.description: The headings' typeface over `font`, from the same fixed set, e.g. `serif` (T-7744).

hero.description: The open data portal's home hero: its title and an introduction in Markdown.

homeWidgets.description: Dashboards the Organization's Portal home page shows, each `project/name` of one of its projects, e.g. `doprava/prehlad`; a viewer sees only those they may read (T-6779).

instanceName.description: Full name on page titles and the login page, e.g. `Mesto Banská Bystrica`.

licenseDefault.description: The licence a new dataset starts with, e.g. `CC-BY-4.0`.

logoSvg.description: The logo as an SVG document of at most 64 KiB, without script, event handler or external reference.

navLinks.description: Links the open data portal's header adds after its own, at most 8, each a label and an `https://` address or a path on the portal, e.g. `{label: Mesto, url: https://mesto.sk}`.

opendataWidgets.description: Dashboards the Organization's open data portal shows on its catalogue home, each `project/name` of one of its projects with `visibility: public`, e.g. `doprava/prehlad`; anonymous readers see them (T-6780).

pages.description: The texts of the open data portal's own pages, each one page in one language in Markdown (T-7031); a page or language left out shows the built-in text.

publisher.description: The legal publisher named in the footer and the open data portal, e.g. `Mesto Banská Bystrica`.

radius.description: The corner radius of cards, buttons and fields in pixels, 0 to 24, e.g. `8`.

shortName.description: Short name on sidebars and tabs, e.g. `BB`.

width.description: How wide the content runs: `narrow`, `normal` (the default) or `wide`.

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource deployment is in progress.
Resource is live and active in cluster.
Reconciliation error.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

PortalBlock.description: One block of a row, told apart by `type`.

oneOf.description: A heading, an introduction, an image and the dataset search box.

image.description: A raster image of the portal's files, e.g. `/files/{sha256}/hero.png`.

intro.description: The introduction per language in Markdown of at most 2 KiB, e.g. `Dáta mesta na **jednom mieste**.`

search.description: Whether the dataset search box shows.

title.description: The heading per language; absent: the portal's title.

oneOf.description: Markdown.

markdown.description: Markdown per language, at most 8 KiB each, e.g. `## O portáli\n\nDáta mesta...`; raw HTML shows as text.

oneOf.description: The datasets a query of this portal's public datasets finds, newest first.

format.description: Only datasets with a distribution of this format, e.g. `CSV`.

publisher.description: Only datasets of this publisher by name, e.g. `mesto-bb`.

tag.description: Only datasets with this keyword, e.g. `doprava`.

theme.description: Only datasets of this theme by its EU code, e.g. `TRAN`.

title.description: The heading per language, e.g. `{sk: Doprava}`.

oneOf.description: Datasets picked by name, in that order.

datasets.description: One to 12 dataset names, e.g. `[ovzdusie-bb, mhd-zastavky]`.

oneOf.description: The map of one dataset with a location, on the deployment's basemap.

dataset.description: The dataset by name, one with a GeoJSON or OGC API Features distribution.

oneOf.description: Counts of the portal's public datasets.

items.description: One to three counts, each once, e.g. `[datasets, publishers]`.

oneOf.description: A chart of one dataset's Endpoint, the chart its own page shows.

dataset.description: The dataset by name whose Endpoint the chart reads, e.g. `ovzdusie-bb`.

oneOf.description: Cards that each link somewhere.
Files of the portal's store to download.

files.description: One to 12 files of the portal, each `/files/{sha256}/{name}`.

oneOf.description: Public datasets.
Publishers with a public dataset.
Public datasets modified in the last 30 days.

menu.description: Whether the header menu lists the page; the home page is the logo's link.

rows.description: The rows from top to bottom.

slug.description: `home` for the home page, else a DNS label such as `doprava`: the page answers at `/page/doprava`.

title.description: The page's title and menu entry per language, e.g. `{sk: Doprava, en: Mobility}`.

PortalRow.description: One row of a page: one to three blocks side by side, stacked on a phone.

blocks.description: The blocks from left to right.

PortalSource.description: One source of a portal (ODP-10). No source carries a credential in this version.

allowedHosts.description: Every host a run may fetch from, the `url`'s own included.

budget.description: Records and bytes one run may read.

convertedFile.description: The deployment's file of converted datasets beside jc.toml, e.g. `od-datasets.json`: only those datasets are listed, with their Endpoint's distributions.

datasetsBase.description: The catalogue base the converted file's dataset URLs name, replaced by this portal's own, e.g. `https://opendata.dev.joinedcontext.com/`.

enabled.description: Whether the source runs on its schedule; `false` keeps it and its records without runs.

gateway.description: The public base the Endpoints of converted datasets answer under.

name.description: Unique in the portal, a DNS label, e.g. `kosice`.

namePrefix.description: A prefix for each record's name, e.g. `ke-`.

publisher.description: The CKAN organisation the records land in, e.g. `kosice`.

publisherUri.description: The publisher's IRI, the one the records name.

requireColumn.description: A column each named dataset must have, dataset to column.

rewriteHosts.description: Hosts in harvested URLs replaced by others, e.g. `{old.sk: new.sk}`.

skip.description: Items left out (title, IRI or item id) with the reason the run log gives.

spatialUri.description: The IRI of the area the records cover.

spelling.description: Spelling fixed in titles and descriptions, wrong to right.

tags.description: `endpoints`: only Endpoints carrying one of these tags.

titles.description: Titles replaced, old title to new.

PortalSourceType.description: Where a [`PortalSource`] takes its datasets from (ODP-10).

oneOf.description: This Organization's already published Endpoints, narrowed by project, space, tag or name.
A DCAT-AP catalogue (Turtle, RDF/XML or JSON-LD), e.g. another deployment's `catalog.ttl`.
A CKAN Action API (`.../api/3/action`).
The Slovak national catalogue's SPARQL endpoint.
An ArcGIS Hub site.
An ArcGIS REST services directory, folder, FeatureServer or MapServer, e.g. `https://gis.example.sk/arcgis/rest/services`: one record per service.
An OGC API Records collection, e.g. `https://data.example.sk/collections/metadata`.

appearance.description: Overrides of the Organization's appearance for this portal only.

hidden.description: Dataset names the portal does not list.

host.description: A host the operator listed for the Organization, e.g. `mobility.bratislava.sk`; absent: the slug address.

languages.description: The languages the portal is shown in, the first one the default, e.g. `[sk, en]`.

organizationRef.description: The Organization the portal belongs to, e.g. `bratislava`.

pages.description: The portal's pages built from blocks (T-7418): `home` replaces the built-in home, each other page answers at `/page/{slug}`; absent: the built-in home alone.

path.description: The portal's name inside the Organization, a DNS label such as `mobility`: `/{org}/opendata/-/mobility/`; `default` is the Organization's own portal.

profiles.description: The profiles its feeds serve beside EU DCAT-AP, e.g. `[dcat-ap-fi-2.0]`; `[]` for EU DCAT-AP alone. Absent, or naming only `dcat-ap-3.0.1`: the catalogue keeps what it serves.

slug.description: With a `host`: what the slug address does.

title.description: The title on every page, per language, e.g. `{sk: Doprava, en: Mobility}`.

SlugAddress.description: How a portal on its own host answers its slug address `/{org}/opendata/-/{path}/` (ODP-08).

oneOf.description: The slug address answers `308` to the same path and query on the host.
Both addresses answer; every page and feed names the host as canonical.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

shard.description: The shard of the WASM host a `wasm` App runs on, recorded at its first publish and kept; the edge's route to the App's server is rendered from it (AP-149).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
